text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A swirl of deception and scheming...
Even knowing how history played out, it still keeps you on the edge of your seat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, my! Is it already this late...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However... going to bed without
seeing how it ends is also..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Ardan ended up staying up late...
